Jewish International Milan (JIM)

Campus-Chabad-House · Milano, Italy

Chabad centre

Previous review (2026-10-06): Shown in official global locator; no local current address confirmation obtained. Research 2026-10-13: The individual JIM locator entry uses Viale S. Gimignano 32 (not Via San Gimignano), with directory ID 6659014. JIMTV donation and privacy pages identify Associazione Culturale Ufarazta at number 10, with Rav Michele Nazrolai. A legal address may differ from visitor premises. The earlier source_url pointed to a Bologna search page. The expanded name Jewish International Milan is not independently verified; official entry is named JIM.
